description: Look up the exact props/signature of an engine-owned `./final/*` helper: the `@/final/ui` primitives (Button, IconButton, Card, Tile, Input, Field, Chip, ListRow, Dialog, Sheet, Toolbar, Heading, EmptyState, cn) plus usePrint, StationHomeButton, SwitchUserButton, useStationHome, Barcode, BootSplash. These are re-asserted into every generated app — compose screens from the primitives (see get_scaffold contracts.designLadder) and import the rest instead of hand-rolling buttons/cards/dialogs, printing, station-home/switch-user, barcodes, or the loading splash. Pass name for a precise lookup, query for fuzzy search, or neither to list all.
name: flow_lookup_engine_component
title: Look up engine helper components
